title: The $q$-Chebyshev function as a defect count
html: To track how defect weight accumulates by norm across the spectral fiber, one deforms the classical prime-counting apparatus. The q-Chebyshev function is this q-deformed prime counting function: it accumulates the weights of fundamental defects ordered by norm. The function \psi_q(X) encodes the distribution of matter across the spectral fiber, weighted by the quantum Planck constant. In the classical limit q \to 1, this recovers the classical Chebyshev function \psi(X).
